name: 4-biphenylcarboxylic acid
description: 4-Biphenylcarboxylic acid (CAS 92-92-2 ), also known as 4-phenylbenzoic acid, is an aromatic carboxylic acid used as a building block and intermediate across pharmaceutical, polymer, and specialty chemical manufacturing. Its rigid biphenyl backbone makes it a preferred structural unit where defined molecular geometry is required in synthesis. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a key intermediate in the synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients. It is particularly useful in the production of sartans and other biphenyl-containing drug compounds. Polymer chemists incorporate it into liquid crystal polymer formulations and high-performance polyesters where thermal stability is critical. Chain rigidity is a critical processing requirement for these materials. In coatings and adhesive systems, it functions as a crosslinking agent and pH modifier, contributing to formulation stability and film integrity. Specialty catalyst development also draws on this compound as a ligand precursor or co-catalyst component in organometallic reaction systems. 4-Biphenylcarboxylic acid is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Standard commercial offerings include technical grade and pharmaceutical-grade material, with purity specifications typically ranging from 98% to 99%+ by HPLC. Packaging is available in laboratory quantities through to bulk industrial volumes. These options support both R&D and commercial-scale procurement for global manufacturers. The material is handled according to strict quality protocols to ensure consistency across different production batches and applications.
